description: S46 T3 (MG8): mcp.grants {agent} for an agent the roster does not carry is the TYPED mcp.unknown refusal (-31852) — the same named-thing fact as an unknown server, now for the AGENT member (the store does not carry the name; the seam knows the names). Never an empty grants view, which would read as "this agent has no tools" when the truth is "that agent does not exist" — MG8's output-honesty runs BOTH ways here, and a phantom agent's empty view is exactly the plausible wrong answer a management console must not render. The `what` names the unknown agent and the known slugs (the seam's sentence via the typed-error pass-through).

error.message: no such MCP server or agent

data.what: the mcp.grants read named agent "reddit-agentz", which is not an agent this store carries; the nearest names are: "reddit-agent", "reviewer", "boss"
data.means: the read answered cleanly and the name is simply absent — this is not the MCP domain declining an operation (that refusal is the mcp.refused code), and nothing was written
